question: Hvar liggja thau 94% af flat->ceiling bilinu sem weeklyProjection lokar ekki?

retrospective: cause classification of every bench regret
method.leakage: Nothing from the classification enters flat or weekly. The classifier is analysis of what happened, not a forecast.
method.lineupEngine: src/lineup.js optimalLineup, input sorted QB,RB,WR,TE to reproduce startsit-lab FLEX tie-breaks (measured: 0/3687 mismatches, 8/3687 unsorted)
method.pairing: same-position pairs first, then cross-position by largest regret; the SUM is pairing-invariant and that is self-tested
method.cascade: availability (started player only) -> role -> defense -> td -> unclassified; order is justified because each earlier cause corrupts the later signals
method.tdCounterfactual: actual TD points replaced by expected TD points from the player's own opportunities (measured per-position rates); sums are preserved per position so the scale is unchanged
method.halfScoring: half = (ppr + standard) / 2, exact algebra; half ADP does not exist historically so PPR ADP is used as a bound (same convention as half-lab.mjs)
method.clustering: bootstrap clustered per player (the player the label is attached to)

A_availability.definition: p10 of opp/oppBase over player-weeks with oppBase>=5, PER POSITION

B_role.definition: p80 of |relative deviation of team-opportunity share from prior-4-week mean|, PER POSITION

C_defense.definition: p80 of |realized position points allowed / DvP expectation - 1|, both normalised to their own league mean, PER POSITION

thresholds.note: Percentiles, not chosen numbers. Per position because a pooled cut is fitted on the WR/RB mass and then never fires for QB — the first version reported role=0.0% for QB, which was a property of the threshold, not a fact about QBs.

ppr.clustering: season (7); these are lineup-level ratios, not sums of player events

half.clustering: season (7); these are lineup-level ratios, not sums of player events

standard.clustering: season (7); these are lineup-level ratios, not sums of player events

invisible.note: Players with no weekly row are filtered out of BOTH lineups and contribute ZERO to ceiling-weekly. Category (a) therefore measures only PARTIAL availability failure and is a lower bound.
